# Security Policy

## Scope

This repository holds the public site and documentation. No contracts are published here, and no coin address has been announced. Any address presented elsewhere as official is unverified.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report privately rather than in a public issue. Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting for this repository. Include:

- a description and the impact,
- steps to reproduce,
- any proof of concept.

## What to expect

We will acknowledge a report, investigate, and tell you what we decide. Please allow reasonable time to fix before disclosing publicly.

## Out of scope

- Findings from third-party data sources the site reads
- Social engineering or impersonation of the project
- Automated scanner output with no demonstrated impact

## Staying safe

- Confirm any address against the README register before using it.
- The team will never ask for a seed phrase or private key.
